entities.name: Oriq Attack on Strixhaven
entities.description: Assault by the Oriq led by Extus Narr on Strixhaven in 4561 AR.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: Oriq leader who summoned the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Mage Hunters
entities.description: Insectoid creatures with violet-glowing spines used by the Oriq.

entities.name: Serafina Onyx
entities.description: Professor who revealed herself to be Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Ice mage who lost his leg to the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Will's sister who channeled the Snarl's energy.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: Massive war creature summoned by Extus.

entities.name: Strixhaven Snarl
entities.description: Volatile magical vortex Extus tried to harness.

entities.name: Hall of Oracles
entities.description: Ancient hall that collapsed in the battle.

entities.name: Dean Nassari
entities.description: Dean who rescued the Kenrith siblings.

entities.name: Lisette
entities.description: Rescued the Kenrith siblings with Nassari.

events.summary: Oriq forces led by Extus Narr attacked Strixhaven with Mage Hunters.
events.quote: the Strixhaven campus in Arcavios was subjected to a large-scale assault by Oriq forces led by Extus Narr

events.summary: Onyx, Kianne and Imbraham coordinated the defense and saw the attack was a distraction.
events.quote: the whole attack was meant as a distraction to darker goings-on

events.summary: Will used ice magic until dragons arrived and Onyx led the siblings through tunnels.
events.quote: Onyx guided the Kenrith siblings through forgotten underground tunnels

events.summary: Extus infiltrated the Biblioplex and Tavver sacrificed himself to impede him.
events.quote: Extus Narr had infiltrated the Biblioplex

events.summary: Extus summoned the Blood Avatar in the Hall of Oracles.
events.quote: Extus succeeded in summoning a massive entity called the Blood Avatar

events.summary: Will and Rowan sealed the Blood Avatar; Extus was crushed and the Avatar cut off Will's leg.
events.quote: Extus was subsequently killed when crushed by the Avatar's hand

events.summary: Nassari and Lisette rescued the siblings as the Hall collapsed.
events.quote: Dean Nassari and Lisette rescued the Kenrith siblings

events.summary: Serafina Onyx revealed her identity as Liliana Vess and took a permanent teaching position.
events.quote: Serafina Onyx revealed her true identity as Liliana Vess
